notes:
- Fixed: with an optic plus a laser, suppressor or grip (for example the Hornet's higher builds), a piece of the gun's barrel floated above the weapon as a long black bar and blocked your view when aiming. Attachments now stay where they belong on every gun.
- Mini Reflex sight: the housing is now an open frame, so you see through it instead of a solid black square.
- Lasers and lights sit low on the side of the handguard, out of your sight picture.
- From 3.12.1: enemy arrows only after spotting; support hand grips every gun.
